evidence.quote: ## Why this rival is strong

The two target pages contain 65 scored events but 42 exact tuple types. Thirty-
two of those types are singletons within the target pair. Each target page also
has a large page-local tail:

| page | events | exact types | singleton types | repeated-type events | attached DY/B3 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| f10r | 38 | 25 | 19 | 19 | 0 / 0 |
| f56r | 27 | 21 | 17 | 10 | 1 / 0 |
| f11r control | 17 | 15 | 14 | 3 | 1 / 0 |
| f55v control | 18 | 16 | 15 | 3 | 2 / 1 |

Every scored Herbal-A physical line is one open field. f10r has no attached
DY/B3 close in any of its five scored lines; f56r has one DY close in seven.
This is the opposite of the short committed-cell ecology that motivated the
Biological form interpretation. It is exactly what line-wrapped prose can look
like after a later parser calls each uninterrupted line a field.

The line openings do not reveal one demonstrated page name. All five f10r
scored lines begin with different exact tuples. The seven f56r openings contain
one repeated local `CHO/SHO` tuple, but otherwise vary. Line endings vary too.
That weakens a fixed row stencil and supports discourse whose clause boundaries
need not coincide with physical lines.

ordinary candidates for shared grammatical or high-frequency technical
vocabulary, not page owners:

| exact tuple | target occurrences | surfaces | structural reading only |
|---|---:|---|---|
| `2f1c5e56...` | 5 | `daiin/taiin` | mobile AIIN card |
| `10488b91...` | 2 | `qotchor/otchor` | cross-page content/function card |
| `276a7c2d...` | 3 | `oky/choky` | cross-page content/function card |

evidence.quote: ## Widersprüche und Grenzen des führenden Modells

- Ein allgemeines Exemplarregister erklärt die Formularform, aber nicht allein,
  warum gerade Pflanzen, Bio-Figuren und Himmelsdiagramme gemeinsam gesammelt
  wurden. Medizinisch-naturkundliche Praxis ist dafür die beste Ergänzung.
- Ein bloßes Lehr- oder Musterbuch erklärt die kostspieligen, inhaltlich reichen
  Bilder und den großen lokalen Kartenrest schlecht. Deshalb ist
  `bedeutungslose Übung` nicht mein Sieger.
- Eine universale Form scheitert an Herbal As langen offenen Artikeln und den
  drei getrennten Astro-Namensräumen. Der Registertyp muss die Form wählen.
- Die medizinische `WHAT/HOW/WHEN`-Lesung erklärt die Bildfolge attraktiv,
  besitzt aber keinen festen seitenübergreifenden Schlüssel. Besonders Astro
  darf nicht durch Prose-Karten nachträglich angebunden werden.

  doch sie decken nur einen kleinen Teil der 381 Prose-Ereignisse. Der größte
  Teil des Fachinhalts bleibt im seltenen Bestand.
- Mehrere Hände können denselben Lehrbestand führen; dies beweist aber weder
  zentrale Werkstattorganisation noch bewusste Geheimschrift.

codex would encode a content-light checklist, nor why Herbal, bathing/apparatus
and astronomical iconography should be selected. Astro could be a local lookup
array, but the prose cards cannot be imported there to prove the proposal.

The medical reading currently gains most of its fluency from silent content:
the picture supplies an owner, the stencil supplies a question, and an isolated
terminal supplies an answer. None of those three links is independently owned
for these 38 events. Calling a terminal-only field a categorical answer and
then using it as evidence that a hidden categorical question existed is
circular.

The recurrent `1C | 3C | 1C | 4O` stencil does show copied form, but it does
not show medicine. The shared alpha ending in the three-card second field of
`f81v.17` and `f82r.7` is equally expected if an apprentice copied a graphic
model. Across the full census alpha is not restricted to that field or that
stencil. More generally, field ordinal is too mobile to support four fixed
medical questions, while page/register confinement is exactly what a local
exercise deck predicts.

The illustrations are the medical theory's strongest advantage, but they do
not decide what the adjacent strings do. Pattern and model books could preserve
figures, plants, letters, and ornaments for reuse. On the fixed pages alone,
the Biological drawings could be silent medical referents, drawing exercises,
or both. The adversarial explanation is therefore:

It explains less iconographic intention than the medical model, but explains
the terminal evidence with fewer invisible semantic objects.
